own_solution.law: Ideal transformer V2 = V1/n; full-wave bridge with two constant-drop diodes in series: v_L = Vm|sin| - 2Vd when Vm|sin| > 2Vd, else 0; average = (1/pi)[2 Vm cos(th0) - 2Vd(pi - 2 th0)], sin th0 = 2Vd/Vm

notes: Base: secondary 57.5 V rms, Vm = 81.3173 V, 2Vd = 1.4 V, th0 = asin(1.4/81.3173) = 0.017217 rad; average = (162.6105 - 1.4*3.107158)/pi = (162.6105 - 4.3500)/pi = 50.376 V (naive 2Vm/pi - 1.4 = 50.373 V, close). With mains 244 V: secondary 61 V rms, Vm = 86.2670 V, th0 = 0.016229 rad; average = (172.5113 - 4.3528)/pi = 53.527 V. Load resistance cancels: with the constant-drop diode model and ideal transformer the load voltage waveform is independent of R (it sets only the current); classed C. Lamp supply and earlier-run sentences have no path to the target: D. Variants consistent at 14 V and 47 ohm; 'small amount' sentences carry no number.
